items: 4 cups hot water (not boiling but hot)
Mix sugar and cornstarch. Gradually add to hot water and cook and stir but do not boil for 10 minutes.
In a blender, combine eggs and lemon juice.
Add half of hot mixture to eggs and juice while blender is running.
Pour back in pan and cook 4 to 5 minutes on medium.
Add salt, butter and lemon extract (optional).

notes.title: Open questions
items: The recipe stops after adding the butter: no crust and no chilling. What crust, and does it chill before serving?
